theme_strategy.vibe: Luxury, Private Banking, Living Organism, Trust
theme_strategy.core_metaphor: The UI is not software; it is a breathing, intelligent executive suite that talks to you.

headings.usage: Used for main greetings (e.g., Daily Briefing), large metrics, and section titles. Evokes a 'private banking' and luxury feel.
headings.weights: Light (300) to Medium (500). Avoid ultra-bold for elegance.

body.usage: Used for all dashboard data, conversational chat bubbles, labels, and small UI text.
body.tracking: Normal. Overlines should be tracking-[0.2em] uppercase.

typography.hierarchy_rules: Maximum heading size is text-5xl or text-6xl for the Daily Briefing entry. Use fluid scales. Never jump more than 2 tailwind steps between heading and subtitle.

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000. Tint neutrals with blue/charcoal. Use Emerald/Ruby/Amber strictly for Vital Signs (Green/Yellow/Red statuses) and Health Scores. Use Gold for gamification, company value, and premium 'CEO DNA' moments.

glassmorphism.name: Crystal Glass
glassmorphism.usage: Use for the Daily Briefing chat overlay, sticky headers, and specific high-value widget cards.

ambient_glow.usage: Cinematic depth behind the 'Living Orb' and key Health metrics.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Dashboard vital cards should NOT be fully glass to ensure data readability. Use flat surfaces (e.g., bg-[#121318] in dark mode) with a subtle 1px border. No muddy gray transparency.

modifications.Card: Remove default borders if using grids. Apply custom border-white/5 for dark mode. Do not overuse Cards; allow bento grid structures to act as boundaries.
modifications.Progress: Use circular SVGs or Recharts for the 'Health Score Ring' and 'Goal Ring'. Shadcn default progress is linear.
modifications.Button: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Hover state must slightly lift (-translate-y-0.5) and increase glow.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (Bento style). Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-6. Mix 1x1, 2x1, and 2x2 spans. Ensure full height stretch on cards.
grids_and_layouts.conversational_mode: Full-height focus layout. The CEO Orb sits centrally or top-center. Chat bubbles flow elegantly from bottom-up or within a central column (max-w-3xl).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 inside metric cards to prevent data collision. Use massive padding (py-24) for the CEO DNA onboarding.

motion_and_interactions.living_orb: The CEO presence must be animated. A CSS/Framer Motion glowing sphere that 'breathes' (scales 1 to 1.05 over 4 seconds, ease-in-out, infinite). It changes color based on mood or company health (Gold = default, Emerald = excellent, Amber = caution).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use Framer Motion for page routes and staggered entry of dashboard cards. Do NOT use 'transition-all'. Target specific properties.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must lighten on hover and clearly indicate interactivity. Use micro-animations.

3d_and_creative_libraries.framer_motion: Mandatory for the CEO Orb breathing animation, chat message staggering, and bento card reveals.
3d_and_creative_libraries.recharts: Mandatory for the 8-Dimension CEO Score (Radar Chart), Future Engine (Line/Area charts with gradient fills), and Vital Signs mini-sparklines.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphism passes WCAG AA. Use off-white text, not dark gray on black.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements, form inputs, buttons, and key metrics (health score, company value) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media_and_assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' (default) or 'phosphor-icons' for thin, elegant strokes fitting the luxury vibe.

abstract_obsidian_gold.description: Fluid obsidian and gold texture. Use as a subtle, very low opacity (10-20%) background overlay for the 'CEO DNA Onboarding' or entry screen.

executive_portrait_1.description: Professional confident businessman in a grey suit. Use for 'Conservative' or 'Investor' CEO personality avatars.

executive_portrait_2.description: Smiling man in black suit. Use for 'Growth' or 'Familiar' CEO personality avatars.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Start by implementing the 'Daily Intelligent Briefing' as a conversational overlay, featuring the breathing animated Orb (Framer Motion).
Create the 'Living Company Dashboard' bento grid with specific RAG (Red/Amber/Green) colored vital signs. Use circular progress for Health (0-100).
Integrate Recharts for the CEO Score Gamification (Radar chart) and Future Engine (Forecast line chart).
Ensure 'Cormorant Garamond' is applied to large UI headings to maintain the private banking aesthetic.
Do NOT use pure black backgrounds or pure white text. Use #0B0C10 for base and #EDEDED for primary text.
Apply data-testid to every interactive and data-bearing element.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism effects (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder text or placeholder image URLs for assets. Always use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui.
